name: Novotel Suites Hanoi
short_description: A 4-star apart-hotel with 151 studios in Hanoi's Cau Giay district, near the Vietnam National Convention Center and Keangnam Landmark Tower, holding a 4.8/5 ALL Rating (645 reviews).
ai_summary: Novotel Suites Hanoi is a 4-star apart-hotel in the emerging Cau Giay district in western Hanoi, with 151 studios featuring kitchenettes and contemporary ensuites, built for both short and long stays. Nearby attractions include the Vietnam National Convention Center, major embassies, Keangnam Landmark Tower, Van Phuc Silk Village, and the Ethnology Museum. Facilities include a swimming pool, fitness centre, sauna, 4 meeting rooms, a convention space, and a business centre. The hotel holds a 4.8/5 ALL Rating from 645 reviews on its own Accor page. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.
